tone_attributes: High clinical clarity: translating complex medical concepts into simple Hindi/English
Strict NMC ethical compliance: zero superlatives, zero promotional hype, zero guarantees
Patient-centric: empowering unhurried, informed decision making for families
voice_and_tone.perspective: Objective clinical educator ('In our clinical evaluations', 'When counseling cataract patients', 'What we look for in a dilated exam')
contrarian_rules: NEVER use superlatives or claims of superiority ('Best eye doctor', 'Top surgeon', '100% painless', 'Guaranteed vision').
NEVER claim that eye drops, ayurvedic tonics, or exercises can dissolve a formed cataract.
NEVER post commercial discounts, package deals, or countdown urgency timers.
ALWAYS emphasize that Instagram carousels are strictly educational and do not replace an in-person dilated eye examination.
Always provide balanced, transparent pros and cons when explaining Monofocal, Toric, and Multifocal/EDOF lenses.
hook_archetypes: The Clinical Dilemma: 'When is the safest time to operate on a cataract (motiabind)?'
The Medical Mythbuster: 'Can eye drops really dissolve a cataract without surgery?'
The Decision Framework: 'Monofocal vs Toric vs Multifocal IOLs: How to choose for your lifestyle.'
